text:
𝗧𝗢𝗦𝗦 𝗨𝗣𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗘 🇮🇳

Shreyas Iyer wins the toss and India will bowl first in the 4th ODI at Mount Maunganui.
Gaikwad and Kuldeep come in; NZ make 6 changes. India lead 2-0.

Series sealed today? 👇

#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗧𝗢𝗦𝗦 𝗨𝗣𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗘: 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗕𝗢𝗪𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚 🇮🇳

👉 Shreyas Iyer ne toss jeeta, India pehle bowling karega
👉 Ruturaj Gaikwad aur Kuldeep Yadav playing XI mein aaye
👉 New Zealand ne 6 changes kiye hain
👉 India series mein 2-0 se aage, Iyer ne ise knockout jaisa match bataya

Kya aaj hi series pakki hogi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
